description: Original HydroSHEDS reach identifier.
UUIDv7 identifier of this object; existing generated IDs are preserved.
Original downstream reach identifier; -1 marks an outlet.
Underscore-separated original STRM_ID values of immediately upstream reaches; empty string means none recorded.
HydroSHEDS watershed identifier; scope of river name identities.
Original HydroSHEDS upstream network-node identifier, not a reach or project UUID.
Original HydroSHEDS downstream network-node identifier, not a reach or project UUID.
Source HydroSHEDS reach length; not recalculated to include project coastal extensions.
HydroSHEDS upstream contributing raster-cell count at this reach.
HydroSHEDS upstream contributing drainage area; not the area of this individual reach catchment.
HydroSHEDS Strahler stream order.
True when the project added a coastal extension to the original source centerline.
Recorded evidence used to support a coastal extension; empty string when no extension evidence is recorded.
Recorded length of the coastal gap assessed by the extension workflow; zero when no gap is recorded.
Modeled drainage centerline geometry in EPSG:4326, including flagged project coastal extensions; not a surveyed channel boundary or water-surface width.
UUIDv7 foreign key to water geographic names.id.
JSON array of additional accepted name UUIDs on this geometry; all accepted names when no preferred name was selected.
Recorded reach applicability status or accepted/not_applicable water-body association status.
Workflow classification of the reach name assignment, including direct, propagated, alternative, unnamed or withheld outcomes.
Evidence or propagation method used to determine naming applicability on this reach.
Recorded workflow decision rule explaining the selected, unnamed or withheld assignment; see readable_status for its applicability class.
JSON array of competing name UUIDs; not assignments.
JSON array of unselected type-pending name UUIDs.
